caveat: Like-for-like replacement of existing roofing on a single-family dwelling costing $40,000 or less does not require a building permit under N.C.G.S. 160D-1110(c) (addition of roofing is carved in; replacement is carved out). NC OSFM guidance (10/19/2023) reads the exemption as replacement of roofing plus up to 15% of existing roof deck. A permit is still required if cost exceeds $40,000, load-bearing structure is added/repaired/replaced beyond that deck allowance, or new roofing is added. If a permit is issued, LUESA Section II.A applies ($59.70 + $12.19/$1,000 over $3,000) plus a $3 technology charge.
